PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-post-004.text: Authorization grant and token issuance events must produce auditable log entries.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-post-004.assertion: forall grant(user, app, code): audit_log.contains(event(user.id, app.id, timestamp))

locations.note: create_user_consent and create_authorization_code RPCs — only console.log for debug; no audit_log table write
Token issuance path — no audit log entry; only delete_authorization_code after token grant
